title: Medication Refill Lead Time
dataSources: Pendant alerts (`care:pendant`), medication adherence (`care:medication`), wandering alerts (`care:geofence`), check-ins (`care:checkin`), care-plan follow-up (`care:ops`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — PERS pendant alerts, medication blister-pack reminders, and wandering geofence signals — streamed to Splunk HEC via caregiver apps, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=care:medication medication_name=* refill_due_epoch=* active=*
| eval days_left=round((refill_due_epoch-now())/86400,1)
| where active="yes"
| table medication_name active days_left
| sort days_left
description: Lists open medication refills with time remaining for medication continuity.
value: Time-left monitoring helps prevent quiet deadline misses across the operational details that support medication continuity.
implementation: Store an expiry timestamp on `care:medication` events and filter for open or unfinished medication refills.
visualization: Table of open medication refills sorted by time remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges which medication refills are about to run out of time so you can deal with them before medication continuity slips.
